text:
I read all 10 files. These are the problems I found, most important first.

**High**
1. `public/robots.txt:5-6` – `Bingbot` has `Disallow: /`. This takes the site out of Bing, and Bing's index feeds Copilot, ChatGPT search and others. It also contradicts `geo.config.json:1`, which says AI search crawlers should be allowed. Fix: delete the Bingbot group.
2. `app/routes/changelog.tsx:4-6` – Entries load client-side in `useEffect` from `/api/changelog`. Crawlers and AI bots that don't run JavaScript see an empty list. Fix: fetch in a Remix `loader` and render server-side.
3. `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` – There is no `meta` export, so there's no title, description or canonical. The page says only "Talk to us for a quote", so it has no citable content. Fix: add `meta` and put real plan and price details in the page.

**Medium**
4. `public/robots.txt:8-9` – Only `GPTBot` is blocked, but the policy says to block all training crawlers. Fix: add groups for `CCBot`, `Google-Extended`, `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `Applebot-Extended` and `Bytespider`. Keep `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User` and `PerplexityBot` allowed, and consider listing them explicitly.
5. `public/robots.txt` (whole file) – There is no `Sitemap:` line. Fix: add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`.
6. `app/root.tsx:2` – The site-wide description is generic. `app/routes/_index.tsx:2` also sets a description, so `root.tsx` only acts as a fallback. Fix: keep the fallback short and make sure each route sets its own.
7. `app/routes/_index.tsx:9` – "See all features" is a `<div onClick>` with `navigate()`. Crawlers can't follow it, and it isn't keyboard-accessible. Fix: use `<Link to="/features">`. As it stands, `/features` is only reachable from the sitemap.
8. `app/root.tsx:7` – The nav has no link to Features or Home, and it uses plain `<a>` tags, which cause full page reloads. Fix: add the missing links and use `<Link>`.
9. `app/routes/_index.tsx:8` – "Integrates with all the tools you already use" is vague. Fix: name the specific integrations (Jira, Slack, GitHub and so on).
10. `app/routes/features.tsx:2` – The content is one thin sentence. Fix: expand it into sections with `h2` headings, each answering a specific question.

**Low**
11. No structured data anywhere (`app/root.tsx`, `app/routes/_index.tsx`). Fix: add JSON-LD for `Organization` and `SoftwareApplication`, plus `Product`/`Offer` on the pricing page.
12. `app/routes/dashboard.tsx:1` with `public/robots.txt:3` – `noindex` plus `Disallow` means crawlers never fetch the page, so they never see the `noindex`. This is harmless here because the page is private. If you want it reliably out of search results, remove the `Disallow` line.
13. `public/sitemap.xml:3-6` – There are no `<lastmod>` values. Fix: add them.
14. `app/root.tsx:2` – There are no Open Graph, Twitter or `og:image` tags. Fix: add them.
15. `app/routes/_index.tsx:2` and `app/routes/changelog.tsx:2` – The canonical URLs are hard-coded. The `https://atlasroadmaps.example` origin is repeated across the route files and `geo.config.json`. Fix: read the origin from one shared constant.
16. The repo has no `llms.txt`. This is optional, but a short one would help AI crawlers find your key pages.

I haven't changed any files. I can apply these fixes if you'd like.
